adjudication.rationale: In the new sync path, `refreshOAuthTokens` returns the raw `fetch(...)` result (a `Response`) when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId` (packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts). In HubSpot, the code now does `const hubspotRefreshToken: HubspotToken = await refreshOAuthTokens(..., "hubspot", credential.userId)` (packages/app-store/hubspot/lib/CalendarService.ts). There is no JSON parsing/validation layer here, so under the sync path `hubspotRefreshToken` will actually be a `Response`, not a `HubspotToken`, making properties like `expiresIn`/`accessToken` undefined and breaking refresh logic; this can lead to persisting invalid data depending on subsequent code.
